reserve_profile.summary: MIM is issued through isolated Abracadabra lending markets against supported collateral. Exposure varies by cauldron and deprecated markets must be separated from active issuance routes.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Collateral release through debt repayment or secondary-market exit
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Borrowers with active cauldron positions can repay MIM debt to release collateral; other holders generally rely on market or protocol liquidity.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Cauldron interest, liquidation, gas, and market costs may apply.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Interface and market availability may vary by jurisdiction and current protocol configuration.

reserve_profile.summary: FEI historically used protocol-controlled value. The final-redemption design described FEI as backed 1:1 by DAI with zero fees during the Tribe DAO wind-down.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: DAI under the historical final-redemption design
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: FEI holders subject to the availability and state of the final-redemption contracts or interfaces.
redemption_profile.fee_text: The final-redemption proposal described zero fees; current execution conditions require verification.

reserve_profile.summary: Historical USDN supply was backed through WAVES held by Neutrino smart-contract mechanics, with later recapitalization systems including NSBT and SURF. This profile is historical because USDN transitioned to XTN.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Historical WAVES contract mechanics or later XTN system
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Historical USDN holders were subject to Neutrino smart-contract, recapitalization, liquidity, and later XTN transition mechanics.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Historical protocol spreads and transaction fees applied.
